title: vaccinium stamineum var. interius
intro: Vaccinium stamineum var. interius, commonly known as the mountain cranberry, is a plant species within the heath family. It is a type of low-growing, woody shrub native to the mountainous regions of North America. The health benefits of Vaccinium stamineum var. interius include its potential to support kidney function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress.
